name: Griffith Sports Excellence Scholarships
summary: Scholarships for elite athletes competing nationally or internationally while studying at Griffith.
key: $28,000 for the Full Scholarship; $5,000 for the Development Scholarship.
who: Competing at an elite level (nationally or internationally) in your sport.
Commencing or current undergraduate or postgraduate coursework student.
Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
Include a coach referee report and a list of sporting achievements.
